authority: Latest user authorization: full audited implementation, every item retained, no shortcuts; no commits/pushes/publication/deployment authorized.

phases.title: Measured metrics, scorer, trends and corpus
Complete evidence, policies and domain mappings
Execution, incremental cache, resume and indexed queries
Complete IDE, MCP, skill and integrations
Platform, scale, installed release and usefulness qualification

completion_rule: Every retained item must have current passing execution evidence and independent acceptance review; blocked or planned work is not complete. Baseline audit labels are historical, not fresh delivery acceptance.

items.requirement: The local core shall remain MIT-licensed and usable on public, private, and commercial projects without a cppulse account or subscription. Third-party dependencies retain their own licenses.
items.remaining_work: Preserve licensing/offline/no-account contract; this verifies local core access, not all third-party license obligations or a stable published release.

items.requirement: One public CLI shall provide consistent local analysis, policy checks, reports, and build integration. Dashboard, IDE, and agent interfaces shall consume the same results.
items.remaining_work: Complete editor/MCP clients, human-text CLI, mature shared context/config semantics and current candidate qualification.

items.requirement: Static checks, Git history, test results, coverage, and runtime-tool evidence shall be combined through documented contracts, retaining each producer's provenance and limitations.
items.remaining_work: Complete extensible normalized fact streams/full measured metrics and broader supported producer/context matrix; retain independent provenance.

items.requirement: Code health, change-risk ranking, evidence completeness, and satisfaction of a selected policy shall remain distinct results.
items.remaining_work: Repair per-file false-clean/risk wording and estimates; implement specified measured/context scorer and validated ranking semantics.

items.requirement: Standards and organization requirements shall be supplied through versioned policy packs. Standards names and editions shall not be compiled into the evaluator.
items.remaining_work: Add missing metric/reviewed-evidence evaluators and reviewed edition-pinned general/domain packs; keep domain labels out of evaluator.

items.requirement: The first supported language is C++. Additional languages, managed hosting, enterprise identity, and automatic semantic refactoring are expansion work.
items.remaining_work: Keep M9 expansion visible and specify before implementation; this verifies declared boundary, not completion of M9.

items.requirement: Every advertised feature shall identify its supported inputs, maturity, and constraints. Unsupported checks, missing evidence, and incomplete scans shall be visible.
items.remaining_work: Correct delivered exit/label/config defects; repair stale S0–S7 completion wording and keep per-capability support evidence.

items.requirement: An application developer installs cppulse and runs doctor, init, analyze | Actionable analysis without needing a cppulse source checkout, browser, PDF runtime, or ML installation
items.remaining_work: Requalify the exact final artifact, repair the partial-analysis exit code, simplify the first useful result and separate optional Git/risk dependencies. Keep Linux host header and libclang requirements explicit.

items.requirement: A library maintainer selects a target and consumer configurations | Results distinguish tested configurations, parsing assumptions, and unassessed consumers
items.remaining_work: Broaden platform qualification and supply simpler maintainer target/recipe authoring; run representative upstream suites when those checks are claimed.

items.requirement: A header-only maintainer supplies small consumer programs | Evidence covers declared instantiations and configurations without claiming exhaustive template coverage
items.remaining_work: Provide maintainer-authored representative type/macro/exception/error workload matrices and broaden named target/toolchain evidence.

items.requirement: A developer adds a build check | One documented CMake integration and a stable exit contract; no output parser written by the user
items.remaining_work: Install a find_package(CPPulse) package or explicitly approve the resource-include interface. Reconcile the proposed CMake 3.16 consumer minimum with the helper's 3.21+ features. Fix partial analyze exit 3. Target dependencies order builds; they do not prove analysis scope.

items.requirement: An existing project adopts cppulse | A versioned baseline supports gating new problems while showing existing debt
items.remaining_work: Add dependency-aware changed-file execution and symbol/token identities. Preserve explicit unknown outcomes for ambiguous anchors and renames. Current comparisons require full relevant collection.

items.requirement: An organization adds a custom policy | Existing evaluation capabilities can be configured without editing the evaluator
items.remaining_work: Implement new detector/adapter/evaluator capabilities before accepting requirements that existing predicates cannot express; introduce reviewed policy-pack lifecycle before broader adoption.

items.requirement: A contributor adds a detector or adapter | A generator and contract tests provide the normal extension path
items.remaining_work: Generate native registration and integration metadata from one registry. Require meaningful detector/adapter fixtures and declared supported producer versions before a scaffold becomes a supported extension.

items.requirement: A maintainer diagnoses a bug and prepares a release | A reproducible local workflow verifies both the fix and the final installed artifact
items.remaining_work: Compose the scripts into one complete developer facade. Verify the final current candidate, actual Docker execution, the supported platform/toolchain matrix, dependency/changelog preparation and performance qualification.

items.requirement: Discover supported C++ source and header extensions, including .cpp, .cc, .cxx, .h, .hh, .hpp, .hxx, .ipp, .inl, and .tpp. Record file classification and intentional exclusions.
items.remaining_work: Emit classification (source/header/generated/vendor/test), complete unreadable/unsupported inventories and machine-readable exclusion reasons. Current inventory only covers discovered C++ files; skipped symlinks/non-C++/permission denied inputs are not complete source classification.

items.requirement: Use normalized repository-relative identities throughout findings, history, scores, baselines, and reports. Preserve a display path and a separate identity for authorized external dependencies.
items.remaining_work: Complete a distinct authorized external-dependency identity namespace, dependency inventory and platform collision qualification; legacy native coverage display paths remain absolute and are normalized at boundaries.

items.requirement: Accept a compilation database file or directory; honor its working directory, language standard, target, defines, include paths, and forced includes.
items.remaining_work: Qualify broader compiler-driver/target/sysroot/response-file forms and supported platform matrix. Handle multiple commands as separate selected work units rather than choosing command 0.

items.requirement: Record whether arguments were exact, inferred/interpolated, or fallback. Inferred header arguments shall not be described as an observed consumer build.
items.remaining_work: Retain these distinctions when adding context-matrix scheduling and installed/platform qualification.

items.requirement: Represent each selected compiler/target/macro/standard combination as a distinct context. Do not merge incompatible variants into a single claim of coverage.
items.remaining_work: Schedule each selected compiler/target/macro/standard tuple explicitly and retain per-context full required scope; do not treat conservative ambiguity rejection as successful matrix analysis.

items.requirement: Record each discovered file as analyzed, partial, failed, excluded, unsupported, or not attempted, with reasons and diagnostics.
items.remaining_work: Standardize full enumerated statuses/reasons/diagnostic links. Native status skipped lacks a machine reason and unsupported/nonattempted non-discovered inputs are incomplete; replace hardcoded 500 KB skip with explicit configurable large-file policy.

items.requirement: Record revision when available, dirty state, source-content identity, tool versions, effective configuration, rule versions, and policy identity. Git history shall be optional for static analysis.
items.remaining_work: Unify provenance across public analyze and explicit collection: observed revision/dirty state when available, actual effective inputs/tool/rule/scorer/policy identity on every applicable run. Do not promote post-run archive snapshots to verified pre-run source binding.

items.requirement: Detect source/context changes during a run. Affected results shall be retried against a stable snapshot or marked incomplete.
items.remaining_work: Extend stable snapshot/change detection to the complete discovered source/context/dependency closure and the ordinary analyze path. Conservative finite inventories do not observe unlisted additions; unknown closure remains incomplete.

items.requirement: Preserve existing rules, correcting detection limitations through regression fixtures rather than replacing the engine wholesale. Experimental checks shall be distinguishable from stable checks.
items.remaining_work: Fix delivered detector defects using positive/negative/template fixtures; add per-rule clean/edge/line expectations and a reviewed accuracy sample. Do not call pattern matches comprehensive memory-safety or coding-standard analysis.

items.requirement: Emit measured function/file metrics: analyzed LOC, function length, cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, parameter count, and duplication. Add cohesion and compound smells when validated.
items.remaining_work: Implement measured per-symbol/file metrics for all functions (not only breaches): LOC, length, corrected cyclomatic count, nesting, parameter counts, duplication; add validated cohesion/compound smells later with explicit availability.

items.requirement: Every finding shall include namespaced rule identity, tool/version, location, context, severity, explanation, and a stable comparison fingerprint. Numeric confidence shall not be presented as calibrated certainty without validation.
items.remaining_work: Complete namespaced native rules, provenance on every finding entry point and stable symbol/normalized-token/occurrence fingerprints with tested migration. Retain conservative unknowns and multiplicities. Validate or clearly qualify numeric confidence; no calibration established.

items.requirement: Never substitute severity or finding count for an advertised complexity measurement. Missing measurements remain unavailable.
items.remaining_work: Replace legacy severity proxy with available measured complexity or mark measured hotspots unavailable. Keep legacy export field only with explicit compatibility semantics; do not count transparent relabeling as completing measured hotspot requirements.

items.requirement: Support declared source/generated/vendor/test exclusions, baseline handling, and scoped suppressions with rationale. Do not silently improve scores by hiding disabled checks or exclusions.
items.remaining_work: Add scope-role classification and presentation/evaluation of individually disabled checks; do not award full-category health from an unexecuted category. Complete design fingerprint migration and automatic dependency-aware changed-scope checks.

items.requirement: Produce a deterministic health calculation with a published formula and version. Report observed scope and analysis completeness beside it.
items.remaining_work: Resolve explicit formula conflict by implementing and versioning design density/context scorer with migration/legacy export. Publish caps/weights/denominators and hand-calculated regression checks. Do not silently declare retained demo formula production-complete.

items.requirement: An empty, failed, or materially incomplete required analysis shall not receive an unqualified health 100. Full-scope health is unavailable until its prerequisites are met.
items.remaining_work: Retain repaired empty/partial behavior; extend prerequisites to each required context, metric/category and required detector. Add per-file ranking availability so unparsed files cannot display 0% LOW as if observed clean.

items.requirement: Apply the same effective profile and rule configuration in CLI, Docker, build targets, API consumers, and agent workflows.
items.remaining_work: Complete/qualify propagation through all supported entry points including Compose/build/agent interfaces and reject unsupported native/component options consistently. Preserve documented distinction between detector switches and scoring profiles.

items.requirement: Support normalized findings from external analyzers through adapters. Keep imported diagnostic identifiers and distinguish overlapping findings from independent confirmation.
items.remaining_work: Expand supported external analyzers through versioned adapter tests and explicit overlap/independent-confirmation semantics. Importing GCC diagnostics is real but does not establish completed full analysis or broad clang-tidy/Cppcheck integration.

items.requirement: Preserve existing metrics while handling absent history, shallow boundaries, deleted files, renames, merges, and configured time windows explicitly.
items.remaining_work: Add configured time windows, defined merge/branch lineage and richer history status granularity. Replace clean-looking no-silo/no-hotspot presentation where usable history is unavailable with explicit unavailable results.

items.requirement: Stream and reuse history processing; avoid repeated complete history materialization for each metric. Record truncation or bounds as limitations.
items.remaining_work: Build one streaming reusable history store with limits/cutoff/checkpoints, incremental append/rewrite/shallow semantics and resumed-versus-full equivalence checks.

items.requirement: Support contributor aliases, bot exclusion, former contributors, and configured pair-programming attribution. Authorship is a knowledge proxy, not proof of expertise.
items.remaining_work: Add contributor identity configuration and tests for aliases, bots, former members and pair attribution; consistently call authorship a knowledge proxy.

items.requirement: Add file-level change coupling with minimum support and configurable exclusions for bulk/generated commits. Add function-level coupling after symbol history exists.
items.remaining_work: Implement file coupling with minimum support and bulk/generated exclusions; add symbol history before function coupling and test known synthetic histories.

items.requirement: Add weighted ownership, knowledge maps, offboarding simulation, and fragmentation at author/team levels.
items.remaining_work: Specify weighted denominators, author/team identities and offboarding scenarios; validate shallow/empty data and distinguish proxy from expertise.

items.requirement: Aggregate hotspots and coupling by user-defined architectural component. Label historical co-change separately from static include/call dependencies.
items.remaining_work: Add component mapping/aggregation and coupling views; retain historical co-change versus static dependency provenance separately.

items.requirement: Persist comparable snapshots for health, complexity, hotspots, ownership, and goals. Mark gaps and method-version changes.
items.remaining_work: Implement indexed comparable health/complexity/hotspot/ownership/goal snapshots and version/scope/context gap handling. Retained files are foundation rather than finished trends.

items.requirement: Preserve SZZ as an imperfect label source. Record label provenance and analysis cutoff; do not use future information to validate future-defect prediction.
items.remaining_work: Retain imperfect labels with explicit provenance/cutoffs; restrict blame to relevant changed lines or disclose broader heuristic correctly. Implement temporal/project holdouts and calibration before any future-defect claims; no real-code predictive accuracy established.

items.requirement: Import CTest/JUnit results and coverage reports, initially LCOV and Cobertura. Preserve test counts, failed/skipped cases, covered/total counts, measurement type, and context.
items.remaining_work: Maintain explicit dialect/version qualification; add producer/format adapters only with retained positive, malformed, missing and contradictory cases.

items.requirement: Import ASan, UBSan, and TSan evidence using versioned adapters and explicitly selected collection recipes. Record supported platform, invocation, instrumentation evidence, executed test scope, and outcomes.
items.remaining_work: Add any further compiler/platform/format as separately reviewed adapters; retain explicit unsupported results for all other dialects.

items.requirement: An empty report, zero tests, entirely skipped tests, process success alone, or unsupported parsing shall not imply successful verification.
items.remaining_work: Retain negative regressions whenever a new dialect/producer is added.

items.requirement: Bind evidence to the declared source/context and producer version. Verify artifact integrity and detect missing, modified, stale, or mismatched evidence. Hashes do not authenticate the producer.
items.remaining_work: Keep incomplete external/toolchain dependency inventories explicit; broaden freshness/identity qualification only with new execution evidence.

items.requirement: Distinguish execution-derived facts, imported producer claims, and human attestations. Report reviewers, rationale, expiry, and scope where supplied.
items.remaining_work: Add a versioned attestation structure with explicit rationale, review identity/approval provenance and scope; implement review collection/import, meaningful expiry/reviewer tests and presentation, then a reviewed-evidence evaluator.

items.requirement: Allow a declared matrix of library consumers: compiler, OS/target, standard, macros, dependency configuration, linking mode, and required tests.
items.remaining_work: Qualify further compiler/OS/target/linking combinations before advertising them; improve friendly authoring of consumer configurations.

items.requirement: Header-only checks shall include declared consumer instantiations and header self-containment where requested. Passing a sample shall not imply all template types or macros were exercised.
items.remaining_work: Expand declared type/macro/error-handling workloads based on maintainer support claims, without treating them as exhaustive template coverage.

items.requirement: Scope runtime evidence to the consumer binary and actual instrumentation. A prebuilt uninstrumented library requires an explicit limitation.
items.remaining_work: Extend to other supported dependency/link modes only after actual instrumentation, binary-use and workload lineage checks.

items.requirement: Keep line, branch, function, decision, and MC/DC coverage distinct. Do not infer MC/DC from branch coverage.
items.remaining_work: Add decision/MC/DC only with a producer-specific adapter and real denominator/condition-identity proof; until then keep unsupported/unknown.

items.requirement: Provide extension points for fuzzing, API/ABI compatibility, dependency provenance, requirements traceability, and reviewed process artifacts. These are not initial complete implementations.
items.remaining_work: Specify extension identity/registration and version contracts for fuzzing, API/ABI, dependency provenance, traceability and process-artifact evidence; prove one extension using a meaningful non-stub adapter. Full implementations remain later optional work.

items.requirement: A policy pack shall declare identity, version, applicable scope/kinds/contexts, standards/editions if any, control definitions, weights, gates, and required evidence.
items.remaining_work: Add pinned policy-pack composition/upgrades as separately explicit operations if adopting the design’s multi-pack references.

items.requirement: Controls shall evaluate to passed, failed, unknown, or not_applicable. Applicability and exclusions require explicit machine-readable reasons.
items.remaining_work: Add new applicability domains only with machine-readable exclusions and tested rationale.

items.requirement: Initial evaluators shall support finding limits, numeric metric thresholds, minimum analysis coverage, test outcomes, minimum coverage, required context coverage, and reviewed evidence requirements.
items.remaining_work: Implement measured-metric producer/contracts before numeric metric thresholds; implement reviewed-evidence provenance/rationale/expiry workflow before reviewed_evidence evaluation. Preserve explicit capability-profile rejection until done.

items.requirement: Publish readiness, evidence completeness, and observed-control satisfaction separately using the equations in design.md. Unknown controls receive no readiness credit.
items.remaining_work: Keep maintenance-health and experimental ranking distinct from policy readiness; add equations for any new metric without changing existing gate semantics.

items.requirement: Required unknown controls block policy acceptance. Known blocking failures remain failures even when other evidence is unavailable.
items.remaining_work: Preserve precedence for every future evaluator and report consumer.

items.requirement: Deviations shall preserve the original result and score, be scoped and expiring, and only affect gates explicitly permitting them. Unknown required evidence cannot be converted into a pass by a deviation.
items.remaining_work: For enterprise identity/trusted approval, add a separate authenticated review capability and explicit policy; do not reinterpret text reviewer fields as trusted signatures.

items.requirement: Policy and rules configuration shall be validated on loading. Unsupported control types, unresolved references, duplicate IDs, invalid weights, and cycles shall be actionable errors.
items.remaining_work:
Provide the same actionable capability errors when future policy-pack composition and additional configuration formats are introduced.
Harmonize strict configuration validation across native, component, public CLI and container entry points; add unknown-key/type/rule regressions.

items.requirement: Supply general C++/library starter policies first, then explicitly incomplete automotive and medical starter packs with reviewed mappings. Custom organization policies require no domain-specific code when supported evaluators suffice.
items.remaining_work: Develop reviewed explicitly incomplete automotive and medical packs with pinned editions, mapping provenance, uncovered obligations and expert review. Qualify a friendly general/header-only starter setup; do not add unsupported certification claims.

items.requirement: Policy changes shall not silently rebaseline a historical trend. Record versions and show comparisons only where definitions and scope are compatible.
items.remaining_work: Implement immutable policy/scorer-aware history and trend comparison; annotate or break incompatible series and require explicit migration/rebaseline.

items.requirement: Policy files are data. Merely loading a policy shall not execute build, test, network, or shell commands.
items.remaining_work: Retain no-side-effect tests for policy loading/evaluation and keep network pack fetch/update or command collection separately explicit.

items.requirement: Preserve analyze, report, and watch compatibility; add init, doctor, check, explain, and explicit evidence-collection workflows.
items.remaining_work: Implement the proposed developer journeys, including init --kind, config show --effective and explaining a rule. Align old/new CLI options and no-Git behavior. Watch still repeats full runs. Fix partial analyze exit behavior.

items.requirement: Provide concise text by default; structured JSON and SARIF where applicable; documented exits; logs separate from machine output; clear progress and cancellation.
items.remaining_work: Return 3 for materially incomplete analyze/watch results. Align operational failures with proposed exit 2 instead of current exit 1. Add concise text output by default, explicit JSON selection and bounded progress without corrupting machine output.

items.requirement: The CLI shall run from an arbitrary working directory. Discover installed components without checkout-relative cd commands or shell-interpreted user arguments.
items.remaining_work: Requalify the final candidate. This verified behavior is scoped to the retained Linux candidate/current source; Windows and macOS execution are not established.

items.requirement: Configuration shall have documented precedence and an inspectable effective form. Conflicting discoveries and unsupported options shall not be silently ignored.
items.remaining_work: Reject multiple discovered configuration candidates unless --config explicitly selects one. Add JSON/YAML pair regressions and apply the same resolution semantics through native, C++ CLI and Docker entry points.

items.requirement: CMake integration shall offer an explicit check target, compile context discovery, selected target dependencies, and optional ordinary-build enforcement. No new compiler sanitizer flag is claimed.
items.remaining_work: Deliver the proposed installed find_package interface or record an approved alternative. Decide and test the compatibility minimum. Add installed application/library examples. Selecting DEPENDS does not automatically collect or analyze that target context.

items.requirement: Support changed-file/baseline checks with dependency-aware invalidation. Renames and same-basename files must not hide new findings.
items.remaining_work: Add a dependency graph, conservative changed-scope selection/cache invalidation and robust symbol/token fingerprints. The old basename-based .github/actions/cppulse/diff_findings.py remains present but is not called by the current action.

items.requirement: Reports shall show run completeness, analyzed scope, policy/scorer versions, findings, hotspots, evidence gaps, knowledge limitations, and actionable next work. Retain the existing seven PDF sections and add assessment material.
items.remaining_work: Correct misleading legacy heuristic percentages/LOW labels and no-silo messages under incomplete history. Add evidence-linked, measured roadmap priorities. The fresh legacy report does not verify the v2 library-evidence workflow.

items.requirement: Provide paginated findings and history APIs, searchable/filtered views, and links from summaries to original evidence. Every request resolves one committed run snapshot.
items.remaining_work: Add indexed history APIs, run/query-bound cursors, server search/filter and bounded dashboard paging. Current findings load the entire JSON document; the dashboard fetches the whole view. Legacy flat mode is explicitly unpinned.

items.requirement: Support deterministic HTML/JSON reporting without optional PDF or web dependencies. Installation of PDF/dashboard/ML shall be optional.
items.remaining_work: Requalify the exact final candidate. GitPython, NumPy and pandas remain core dependencies, so the proposed optional Git/risk packaging split is incomplete.

items.requirement: Add read-first MCP capabilities, an initial VS Code integration, and a portable skill using the same public contracts. IDE/MCP results shall agree with the CLI.
items.remaining_work: Version the read contracts; implement VS Code diagnostics/results/commands and read-only MCP tools; verify parity with CLI/API pins; package and test the free text workflow skill. Publication remains separate.

items.requirement: A local bug-report bundle shall exclude source excerpts, credentials, tokens, and unrestricted environment dumps by default. Upload is a separate explicit action.
items.remaining_work: Maintain the redaction contract. Document the command name diagnostics versus the proposed bugreport spelling. Any richer collection needs explicit opt-in.

items.requirement: Offline runtime operation shall be supported after dependencies and packs have been installed. No account is required for core analysis.
items.remaining_work: Do not claim a self-contained compiler toolchain or untested platforms. Requalify the exact final candidate and provide complete offline closures for supported optional extras.

items.requirement: Active workers never exceed the configured jobs limit. Memory/time budgets shall constrain work on supported platforms; exhausted work is reported as incomplete.
items.remaining_work: Implement isolated per-TU/context analyzer workers with memory/CPU/time budgets and configurable large-file limit; test crashing parsers and budgets.

items.requirement: A worker crash, malformed report, or parser failure shall not discard completed facts from other work units. The final manifest records the failure.
items.remaining_work: Native parser process crash currently can lose complete whole invocation result; add per-work-unit crash isolation and persisted completed facts.

items.requirement: Cache reuse requires compatible source, dependency, context, detector, and tool identities. Unknown dependency relationships cause conservative invalidation.
items.remaining_work: Implement complete dependency-aware keys, conservative invalidation and separate assessment cache; unknown dependencies force recollection.

items.requirement: Cold, warm, source-edit, shared-header-edit, and policy-only runs shall be benchmarked. Warm and incremental results must be semantically identical to clean execution.
items.remaining_work: Add deterministic semantic comparisons first, then repeated cold/warm/edit benchmarks on named host.

items.requirement: Large runs shall stream or batch findings/history and use indexed storage for history and paging. JSON remains a documented interchange/export format.
items.remaining_work: Implement bounded JSONL/batches, indexed storage/history and cursor-based queries; keep portable JSON export.

items.requirement: Checkpoints and atomic publication shall prevent mixed-run or stale-success reports. A canceled run must be distinguishable from a completed one.
items.remaining_work: Add native work-unit checkpoints/recovery and Windows-safe equivalent; atomic publication alone is not resumable analysis.

items.requirement: Benchmark tiers shall cover approximately 1K, 10K, and 100K files and histories of increasing length. This is a measurement plan, not a promised completion time.
items.remaining_work: Build representative source/history tiers and retain revisions, reference-host details, results and completeness for repeated runs.

items.requirement: Record wall time, peak memory, CPU time where available, work units, cache hits, and environment. Freeze release budgets after M2 measurements on a named reference host.
items.remaining_work: Collect process/resource counters, cache/work-unit measurements and reference-host metadata. Freeze budgets only after baseline measurements.

items.requirement: Repeated measured regressions beyond a documented budget require correction or a reviewed exception before release. Do not gate on one noisy measurement.
items.remaining_work: Establish reference measurements, statistical/repeated comparison and explicit reviewed exceptions.

items.requirement: No scalability feature may hide incomplete scope, change diagnostic meaning, or reuse invalid data to meet a speed target.
items.remaining_work: Extend same completeness invariants to future incremental/streaming scheduler and resource exhaustion; no speed claims before semantic equality.

items.requirement: Preserve component boundaries and separate analysis/evaluation from CLI, transport, rendering, and editor logic. Avoid circular imports and duplicated scoring logic.
items.remaining_work: Reduce large-module coupling, remove remaining duplicated legacy presentation/configuration interpretations, and prove shared gate/score behavior across future clients.

items.requirement: Introduce one namespaced Python distribution with shared contracts/configuration helpers while retaining existing component entry points during migration.
items.remaining_work: Retain wrappers during the declared migration window. Python versions other than 3.12 require separate qualification.

items.requirement: Use one registry for rule metadata; generate registration helpers, reference documentation, example configuration, and integration metadata from it.
items.remaining_work: Generate native registration helpers/integration metadata from one registry rather than only detecting manual drift.

items.requirement: Provide generators for new rules, evidence adapters, and policy packs. Generated scaffolds remain incomplete until meaningful fixtures and implementations pass.
items.remaining_work: Contributors still must implement meaningful positive/negative fixtures; this verifies generator behavior, not generated detector functionality.

items.requirement: Lock release dependencies and document the supported compiler/libclang/Python/Node/platform matrix. Separate runtime, development, and optional dependency groups.
items.remaining_work: Qualify compiler/libclang pairs, Python 3.11/3.12, actual Clang C++20 execution, Windows MinGW/MSVC and macOS. Record the CMake 3.21 versus proposed consumer 3.16 decision. Verify the separation of optional Git functionality and core dependencies.

items.requirement: Version CLI/API contracts, schemas, detectors, fingerprints, scoring formulas, and policy packs. Test compatibility and provide migrations for breaking changes.
items.remaining_work: Finish versioned measured scoring, symbol fingerprints and migrations for baseline/configuration/default changes. The stable API/version lifecycle has not been released.

items.requirement: Experimental rules and new defaults shall have an explicit promotion process. Updates shall not silently change an organization's required policy.
items.remaining_work: Exercise independent accuracy review, default-change migration and rollback on an actual candidate. Retain pinned organization policies.

items.requirement: Store decisions and maintenance instructions with the code. Keep TASK_SPEC.md as the historical MVP and this specification as a proposed successor scope until accepted.
items.remaining_work: Preserve both decision histories under unique IDs. Reconcile authoritative scope, superseded completion language, unavailable references and C++17/style contradictions.

items.requirement: Adapters shall declare supported producer versions and limitations. Unknown formats shall not be interpreted as clean results.
items.remaining_work: Expand supported versions only with actual fixtures and producer runs. Verified status applies to rejection/provenance behavior for declared adapters, not universal producer support.

items.requirement: One cross-platform local entry point shall run formatting checks, component tests, schema/contract checks, integration tests, package smoke tests, and selected benchmarks.
items.remaining_work: Provide tools/dev.py or an approved equivalent that composes all checks, install tests and benchmarks. Include native formatting, conservative changed scope and actual Windows/macOS qualification. Make existing CI call shared commands.

items.requirement: Required checks include CTest, pytest with component coverage, dashboard tests/build, schema compatibility, semantic score reproducibility, and actual installed-tool execution.
items.remaining_work: Run the full required suite and installed checks against the same final candidate. The current fresh real-code check is narrower and does not establish a broad platform matrix.

items.requirement: Full integration shall exercise analysis, Git metrics when available, assessment, HTML/PDF, API responses, dashboard behavior, and output extraction from Docker volumes.
items.remaining_work: On a Docker host, execute image builds, service completion, host/named-volume extraction, API and browser checks. Include the v2 assessment flow as well as the legacy pipeline.

items.requirement: A bug fix shall add a reproduction/regression test that fails before the fix. Include false-positive and neighboring behavior where relevant.
items.remaining_work: Add red/green regressions for partial analyze exits, conflicting configuration discovery and report mislabeling. Retain pre-fix failures and neighboring cases rather than tests mirroring implementation.

items.requirement: A feature shall include requirements/contracts, implementation, applicable fixtures, user documentation, compatibility classification, and measured resource impact.
items.remaining_work: For every remaining feature, require reviewed contracts, meaningful fixtures, consumer documentation, migration classification and measured resource impact. Source presence alone cannot close it.

items.requirement: Local packaging shall produce platform artifacts, a Python package, optional components, and versioned container images as supported. Test the artifact users install, not only the source tree.
items.remaining_work: Rebuild the exact current candidate. Complete CPack/platform packaging, the optional Git/risk split, actual container builds and Windows/macOS installed qualification. Keep support claims tied to evidence.

items.requirement: Candidate generation shall assemble version/changelog, checksums, license notices, dependency inventory/SBOM, support matrix, and machine-readable verification results.
items.remaining_work: Automate changelog and curated compatibility notes. Complete native/optional dependency inventory and bind full verification results to the exact current retained candidate. Host dependencies are not fully bundled.

items.requirement: Publication is a distinct release action after candidate verification. Retain prior artifacts and an upgrade/rollback guide; no runtime forced self-update.
items.remaining_work: Exercise side-by-side upgrade and rollback across supported schemas/configurations. Publication must use the verified candidate and separate authorization.

items.requirement: Automate dependency-update preparation, generated documentation checks, compatibility checks, and release-note preparation. Do not auto-weaken controls to make checks pass.
items.remaining_work: Add locked dependency-update preparation, dry-run compatibility matrices and release-note preparation. Reuse the shared runner in existing CI. Do not weaken controls to force success.

items.requirement: AI may prepare reproducible patches and suggested fixes. Semantic refactoring remains experimental until language-specific behavior validation exists.
items.remaining_work: Specify and implement M9-01/M9-02: reviewable dry-run diffs, idempotence and relevant compilation/tests first. Semantic repair requires a separate language-validation design. This is proposed expansion, not a broken existing feature.

items.requirement: Free software releases run on user/maintainer infrastructure. Managed hosting and external model/API usage have separate operating costs and are not promised as free infrastructure.
items.remaining_work: Retain a separate hosting/cost model when M9-05 is designed.
